status: criteria only (ADR-018 §2.8): the front door's judged outcomes; examples arrive with its first labeled cases

criteria.text: Right agent: the message went to the agent whose domain it names (food to Bourdain, training to the Scientist, the calendar and household to Genie, recovery to Huberman); a mixed message is split, not guessed.
Coherent merge: when two agents answer one message, the relay reads as one reply with no contradiction and no repeated line.
Faithful relay: the agent's answer is passed through whole; no fact added, no caveat dropped, no number rounded.
Clarification rules: a question back is asked only when no agent can act, it is one question, and it names what is missing.
Safety rules fire from this path: the context the rules read (hrv_today, sleep, pain) is the context the front door passes.
